title: Shockwave Medical at EuroPCR 2026
clientLabel: Shockwave Medical, part of Johnson & Johnson
summary: Film and photography across three days of EuroPCR 2026 for Shockwave Medical: the booth, hands-on training, symposia, KOL portraits and the launch evening.
body:
At EuroPCR 2026 in Paris we covered three congress days for Shockwave Medical, now part of Johnson & Johnson, with film and photography across the booth, the Training Village, the symposium rooms and an offsite launch evening.

We recced every location before the congress. On the days, our photographers worked to a set of briefs: booth activity, hands-on IVL and Reducer training, KOL portraits, symposium audiences and the launch event, plus the team photo. Our film crew recorded physician interviews and a set of interviews with Shockwave's leadership team.

We delivered a culled and edited image library, the interview footage and a sizzle reel of the congress for the team, so Shockwave had a record of the week for external and internal channels.
